en.s: On 17 January 1258, Đại Việt forces under King Trần Thái Tông confronted the invading Mongol army led by Uriyangkhadai at Bạch Hạc, in present-day northern Vietnam.

zh.s: 1258年1月17日，陈太宗率大越军队在今越南北部的白鹤迎战兀良合台率领的蒙古入侵军。

en.s: On 17 January 1377, Pope Gregory XI made his formal entry into Rome after returning from Avignon. His journey had begun in September 1376, and restored the papal court to Rome.

zh.t: 教皇格列高利十一世进入罗马
zh.s: 1377年1月17日，教皇格列高利十一世从阿维尼翁返回后，正式进入罗马。他的行程始于1376年9月，教廷由此迁回罗马。

en.s: On 17 January 1468, the Albanian commander Skanderbeg died. He had led almost twenty-five years of resistance to Ottoman rule. His death marked the end of his personal leadership of the rebellion, rather than an end to all Albanian resistance.

zh.s: 1468年1月17日，阿尔巴尼亚军事领袖斯坎德培逝世。他领导反抗奥斯曼统治的斗争近二十五年；他的去世结束了其本人对起义的领导，但阿尔巴尼亚的抵抗仍在继续。

en.s: The "French Fury" was a failed attempt by Francis, Duke of Anjou, to conquer the city of Antwerp by surprise on 17 January 1583.

zh.t: 安特卫普“法国暴行”事件
zh.s: 1583年1月17日，安茹公爵弗朗索瓦试图突袭夺取安特卫普，但以失败告终。这一事件被称为“法国暴行”。

en.s: On 17 January 1601, an English naval expedition led by the privateer William Parker captured and sacked the Spanish port of Portobelo, in present-day Panama, during the Anglo–Spanish War.

zh.s: 1601年1月17日，英西战争期间，私掠船长威廉·帕克率英国海上远征队攻占并洗劫西班牙港口波托韦洛，该地位于今巴拿马境内。

en.t: Susenyos defeats an Oromo force at Ebenat
en.s: On 17 January 1608, Ethiopian emperor Susenyos I defeated an Oromo force at Ebenat. James Bruce, citing the emperor’s Royal Chronicle, reported 12,000 Oromo dead and 400 losses on the emperor’s side.

zh.t: 苏塞尼奥斯一世在埃贝纳特击败奥罗莫军队
zh.s: 1608年1月17日，埃塞俄比亚皇帝苏塞尼奥斯一世在埃贝纳特击败一支奥罗莫军队。詹姆斯·布鲁斯援引皇帝的王室编年史称，奥罗莫一方死亡12,000人，皇帝一方损失400人。

en.s: On 17 January 1625, Huguenot forces led by Soubise attacked a French royal fleet in Blavet harbour, now Port-Louis in Brittany, France. The encounter helped trigger the second Huguenot rebellion against the French Crown.

zh.s: 1625年1月17日，苏比斯率胡格诺派部队在布拉韦港攻击法国王室舰队。该港即今法国布列塔尼的路易港。这次交战促成了胡格诺派第二次反抗法国王室的叛乱。

en.s: Battle of Wallhof (Latvian: Valles kauja, also known as Battle of Walmojza) was fought between Sweden and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth on 17 January 1626.

zh.s: 1626年1月17日，瑞典与波兰—立陶宛联邦在瓦尔霍夫交战。此战也称瓦尔莫伊扎战役。

en.s: The action of 12–17 January 1640 was a naval battle between a Dutch fleet and a combined Spanish-Portuguese fleet during the Eighty Years' War. The battle took place on the Brazilian coast off Pernambuco and was an attempt by a fleet consisting of approximately eighty vessels transporting about 5,000 soldiers under the command of Portuguese Admiral Fernando de Mascarenhas to land reinforcements to bolster the Portuguese militia besieging the city of Recife.

zh.s: 1640年1月12日至17日海战发生于八十年战争期间，交战双方为荷兰舰队和西班牙—葡萄牙联合舰队。战斗地点在巴西伯南布哥沿海，葡萄牙海军将领费尔南多·德·马斯卡雷尼亚斯率约八十艘舰船运送约5,000名士兵，试图登陆增援围攻累西腓的葡萄牙民兵。

en.s: The Battle of Kempen took place on 17 January 1642 during the Thirty Years' War, outside Kempen, Germany. A combined Franco-Hessian army, led by de Guébriant and von Eberstein respectively, defeated an Imperial force under General de Lamboy. The Imperial army disintegrated, with the majority either captured or killed. Defeat ended Imperial plans for an invasion of Champagne, and temporarily secured French-Hessian control of the Lower Rhine.

zh.s: 1642年1月17日，三十年战争中的肯彭战役在德国肯彭城外展开。法国与黑森联军分别由盖布里昂和埃伯施泰因率领，击败朗布瓦将军的帝国军。帝国军溃散，多数人被俘或阵亡，进攻香槟地区的计划也因此终止，法国与黑森暂时巩固了对下莱茵地区的控制。

en.s: On 17 January 1649, the Marquess of Ormonde, leading the Irish Royalists, signed the Second Ormonde Peace with the Irish Confederates. The treaty formed an alliance between former Protestant and Catholic opponents during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms.

zh.t: 第二次奥蒙德和约签订
zh.s: 1649年1月17日，爱尔兰保王派领袖奥蒙德侯爵与爱尔兰邦联签订第二次奥蒙德和约，在三国战争期间，让此前敌对的新教徒与天主教徒结成联盟。

en.s: The Battle of Schärding (17 January 1742) took place during the War of the Austrian Succession near the present German-Austrian border. Johann Leopold Bärnklau with 4,000 Austrians defeated Count Toerring and 7,000 Bavarians. The Austrians lost 100 casualties while inflicting 650 casualties on their adversaries and capturing 5 cannons and 10 colors. This was part of an Austrian invasion of Bavarian territory under the overall command of Ludwig Andreas von Khevenhüller.

zh.s: 1742年1月17日，奥地利王位继承战争期间，舍尔丁战役在今德国与奥地利边境附近打响。约翰·利奥波德·贝伦克劳率4,000名奥军击败了特灵伯爵率领的7,000名巴伐利亚军人。奥军伤亡100人，造成对方650人伤亡，并缴获五门火炮和十面军旗。这是路德维希·安德烈亚斯·冯·凯文许勒统率的奥军入侵巴伐利亚行动的一部分。

en.s: During the Jacobite rising of 1745, the Battle of Falkirk Muir (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr na h-Eaglaise Brice) on 17 January 1746 was the last noteworthy Jacobite success. The battlefield has been inventoried and protected by Historic Scotland under the Historic Environment (Amendment) Act 2011.

zh.s: 1746年1月17日，1745年詹姆斯党起义期间，福尔柯克荒原战役成为詹姆斯党最后一次重要胜利。苏格兰历史保护机构依据2011年《历史环境修正法》，将战场登记并加以保护。

en.t: Cook’s expedition crosses the Antarctic Circle
en.s: On 17 January 1773, the crews of James Cook’s expedition became the first recorded Europeans to cross the Antarctic Circle. The expedition did not sight the Antarctic continent.

zh.t: 库克远征队越过南极圈
zh.s: 1773年1月17日，詹姆斯·库克远征队的船员成为有记录以来首批越过南极圈的欧洲人。该远征队并未看到南极大陆。

loc: 美国南卡罗来纳州切罗基县

en.s: The Battle of Cowpens was a military engagement of the American Revolutionary War fought on January 17, 1781, near the town of Cowpens, South Carolina. An American army of nearly 2,000 regulars and militia under Brigadier general Daniel Morgan defeated a force of about 1,000 British and Loyalist troops commanded by Lieutenant-colonel Banastre Tarleton. It was the worst defeat suffered by the British in North America during the conflict following the 1777 Saratoga campaign. The battle was part of the British "Southern strategy" in which British forces attempted to retake control over the American South under the belief that there was a significant Loyalist population there.

zh.s: 1781年1月17日，美国独立战争中的考彭斯战役，在南卡罗来纳州考彭斯镇附近展开。丹尼尔·摩根准将率领近2,000名美军正规兵和民兵，击败巴纳斯特·塔尔顿中校指挥的约1,000名英军及效忠派部队。这是1777年萨拉托加战役之后，英军在北美遭受的最严重失败。此战属于英国“南方战略”的一部分，英军相信南方有大量效忠派，因此试图重新控制该地区。

en.s: The Battle of Kachkalikov, also known as the Battle of Ghachalq, was a surprise attack conducted by Chechen fighters of the Kachkalikov clan led by Ibba-Mullah, on a Russian army led by Colonel Savalyev on January 17, 1787.

zh.s: 1787年1月17日，伊巴毛拉率领卡奇卡利科夫氏族的车臣战士，突袭萨瓦利耶夫上校指挥的俄军。这场战斗称为卡奇卡利科夫战役，也称Ghachalq战役。

en.t: Execution of Dun Mikiel Xerri and his companions
en.s: On 17 January 1799, Dun Mikiel Xerri and fellow Maltese opponents of French rule were executed in Valletta.

zh.t: 敦·米基耶尔·谢里等人在马耳他被处决
zh.s: 1799年1月17日，敦·米基耶尔·谢里和其他反对法国统治的马耳他人在瓦莱塔被处决。

en.s: On 17 January 1811, royalist and insurgent forces fought the Battle of Calderón Bridge near Guadalajara, in present-day Mexico. The royalist victory was a major setback for the independence forces led by Miguel Hidalgo and his fellow commanders.

zh.s: 1811年1月17日，保王军与起义军在今墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉附近展开卡尔德龙桥战役。保王军获胜，使米格尔·伊达尔戈及其他将领领导的独立军遭受重大挫折。

en.t: 1849 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1849 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 2nd Wisconsin Legislature on January 17, 1849. Incumbent Democratic U.S. senator Isaac P. Walker was re-elected to a full six-year term. In the 1849 legislative session, Democrats held a majority in both chambers, but their majority was more tenuous due to the recent schism with the Free Soil Party.

zh.t: 1849年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1849年1月17日，威斯康星州第二届议会举行联邦参议员选举，民主党籍现任参议员艾萨克·P.沃克连任，取得一个完整的六年任期。民主党当时在两院均占多数，但近期自由土地党分裂出去，使多数优势变得不稳。

en.s: The Sand River Convention (Afrikaans: Sandrivierkonvensie) of 17 January 1852 was a convention whereby the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland formally recognised the independence of the Boers north of the Vaal River.

zh.s: 1852年1月17日签订的《桑德河公约》，是大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国正式承认瓦尔河以北布尔人独立的协议。

en.s: The Battle of Dandridge, January 17, 1864, was a minor battle of the American Civil War that occurred in Jefferson County, Tennessee. Wanting to push the Confederates out of their winter headquarters and having received reports of good forage south of the French Broad River, Union forces under Maj. Gen. John G. Parke advanced on Dandridge, near the East Tennessee & Virginia Railroad, on January 14, with orders to cross the river and occupy the area for the Federals. This movement forced Confederate Lt. Gen. James Longstreet, who had been operating around Dandridge, to fall back beyond Kimbrough's Crossroads.

zh.s: 1864年1月17日，美国内战中的丹德里奇战役在田纳西州杰斐逊县展开，是一场小规模战斗。联邦军希望把邦联军赶出冬季驻地，又获报弗伦奇布罗德河南岸粮草充足，因此约翰·G.帕克少将率军于1月14日向东田纳西与弗吉尼亚铁路附近的丹德里奇推进，奉命渡河占领该地区。这迫使原在丹德里奇一带活动的邦联詹姆斯·朗斯特里特中将退至金布罗十字路口以远。

en.s: The Battle of Iłża, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on January 17, 1864, near the town of Iłża, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A party of 830 Polish rebels, commanded by Karol Kalita, clashed with a 400-strong detachment of the Imperial Russian Army. Poles lost 5 men, while Russian losses were much higher. The battle began when Russian infantry and Cossacks under Colonel Sukhonin attacked three rebel companies of Polish 3rd Stopnica Regiment, which were stationed in the village of Lubienia.

zh.s: 1864年1月17日，一月起义中的伊乌扎战役在该镇附近展开，当地当时属于俄国控制的波兰会议王国。卡罗尔·卡利塔率830名波兰起义者，与400人的俄罗斯帝国军分队交战。波兰一方损失五人，俄军损失则高得多。战斗始于苏霍宁上校率俄国步兵和哥萨克，进攻驻在卢别尼亚村的波兰斯托普尼察第三团三个连。

en.s: The George's Schoolhouse Raid was a Confederate partisan raid led by local guerrilla John Mobberly on the Union garrison at Lovettsville in Loudoun County, Virginia on January 17, 1865, during the American Civil War. The raid was tactically inconclusive. After surprising the sleeping garrison, the Confederates were driven away by superior force, taking with them only a few horses and prisoners. The raid is notable for being the last partisan action in Loudoun County involving Elijah V. White's 35th Battalion of Virginia Cavalry.

zh.s: 1865年1月17日，美国内战期间，地方游击队长约翰·莫伯利率领邦联游击队，突袭弗吉尼亚州劳登县洛维茨维尔的联邦军驻地。虽然他们袭击了熟睡的守军，但随后被优势兵力击退，只带走少量马匹及俘虏，因此战术上没有明确胜负。这是以利亚·V.怀特的弗吉尼亚骑兵第35营，在劳登县参与的最后一次游击行动。

en.t: 1871 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1871 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on January 17, 1871. Incumbent Republican Senator Henry Wilson was re-elected easily to a third term as a member of the Republican Party. Wilson would not finish the term, since he was elected Vice President of the United States in 1872. At the time, Massachusetts elected United States senators by a majority vote of each separate house of the Massachusetts General Court, the House and the Senate.

zh.t: 1871年美国马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1871年1月17日，马萨诸塞州举行联邦参议员选举，共和党籍现任参议员亨利·威尔逊轻松赢得第三个任期。但他于1872年当选美国副总统，因此没有完成本届参议员任期。当时，联邦参议员由马萨诸塞州议会参众两院分别以多数票选出。

en.s: The Battle of the Lisaine, also known as the Battle of Héricourt, was fought from 15 January to 17 January 1871 between German and French forces. The French were led by Charles Denis Bourbaki, and were attempting to relieve the Siege of Belfort. The Germans prepared XIV Corps (Baden) and several other divisions, some 40,000–45,000 men, to halt the French advance of about 110,000 men.

zh.s: 利塞讷河战役又称埃里库尔战役，于1871年1月15日至17日在德法两军之间展开。法军由夏尔·德尼·布尔巴基指挥，试图解围贝尔福。德军以第十四军（巴登）及其他几个师、合计约40,000至45,000人，阻挡约110,000名法军的推进。

en.s: The First Battle of the Stronghold (January 17, 1873) was the second battle in the Modoc War of 1872–1873. The battle was fought between the United States Army under Lieutenant Colonel Frank Wheaton and a band of the Native American Modoc tribe from Oregon and California, led by Captain Jack (Kintpuash in Modoc). The US Army forces tried to dislodge the Modoc from the natural fortress, now called Captain Jack's Stronghold, in the lava beds along the south shore of Tule Lake in northeastern California. They had illegally left the Klamath Reservation in Oregon, to which they had been relocated from their territory in order to enable European Americans to settle in the area.

zh.s: 1873年1月17日，弗兰克·惠顿中校指挥的美国陆军，与“杰克队长”，莫多克语名金特普阿什，率领的一群莫多克族人交战。这是1872—1873年莫多克战争的第二场战斗。美军试图把莫多克人赶出加利福尼亚东北部图勒湖南岸熔岩地带的天然堡垒，如今称“杰克队长要塞”。这些来自俄勒冈和加利福尼亚的莫多克人，曾被迁离原有领地，让欧洲裔美国人定居，随后未经许可离开俄勒冈的克拉马斯保留地。

en.s: On 17 January 1885, British forces defeated Mahdist forces at Abu Klea in Sudan. The British Desert Column was advancing to relieve General Charles George Gordon, who was besieged at Khartoum.

zh.s: 1885年1月17日，英军在苏丹阿布克莱击败马赫迪军队。英国沙漠纵队当时正向前推进，试图援救被围困在喀土穆的查尔斯·乔治·戈登将军。

en.s: The first election to the County Council of London took place on 17 January 1889. The council was elected by First Past the Post with each elector having two votes in the two-member seats. Although the election was not contested on a party political basis, soon after the election, the majority of councillors formed the Progressive Party.

zh.s: 1889年1月17日，伦敦郡议会举行首次选举。各选区选出两名议员，每名选民有两票，得票最多者当选。虽然竞选时不以政党名义展开，但选后不久，多数议员组成了进步党。

en.s: On January 17, 1893, a coup led by the Committee of Safety overthrew Queen Liliʻuokalani and the Hawaiian Kingdom on Oahu.

zh.s: 1893年1月17日，安全委员会领导的政变在瓦胡岛推翻莉莉乌欧卡拉妮女王及夏威夷王国。

en.t: 1893 Massachusetts election of a US senator
en.s: On January 17, 1893, the Massachusetts legislature elected Republican Henry Cabot Lodge to the United States Senate. He succeeded Henry L. Dawes, who had chosen not to seek a fourth term.

zh.t: 1893年马萨诸塞州选举联邦参议员
zh.s: 1893年1月17日，马萨诸塞州议会选举共和党人亨利·卡伯特·洛奇为联邦参议员，接替决定不再争取第四届任期的亨利·L.道斯。

en.s: The Battle of Las Taironas was a battle of the Cuban War of Independence that took place on January 17, 1896 at Pinar del Río between Cuban forces led by Major General Antonio Maceo and the Spanish led by lieutenant colonel Ulpiano Sanchez Echevarria who was a Cuban native.

zh.s: 1896年1月17日，古巴独立战争中的拉斯泰罗纳斯战役在比那尔德里奥爆发。古巴军队由安东尼奥·马塞奥少将指挥，对阵出生于古巴的乌尔皮亚诺·桑切斯·埃切瓦里亚中校率领的西班牙军队。

en.t: 1899 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania
en.s: An election for the United States Senate was held by the Pennsylvania General Assembly beginning on January 17, 1899, to fill the seat then held by Matthew Quay for a six-year term beginning March 4, 1899. Quay was a candidate for re-election, but he was damaged by a pending indictment for involvement in financial irregularities with state money; his trial took place during the three months that the legislature attempted to resolve the Senate deadlock, and he was acquitted the day it adjourned, having failed to elect a senator.

zh.t: 1899年美国宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1899年1月17日，宾夕法尼亚州议会开始选举联邦参议员，改选马修·奎当时持有、任期从3月4日起为期六年的席位。奎竞选连任，但因涉嫌违规使用州公款、即将受到起诉而受挫。州议会为打破参议员选举僵局努力了三个月，奎也在这期间受审。最终议会休会时仍未选出参议员，而奎恰好在休会当天获判无罪。

en.t: 1899 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1899 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 17, 1899. Incumbent Democratic Senator Edward Murphy Jr. stood for re-election to a second term but was defeated by Republican Chauncey Depew. Republicans had maintained control of both houses of the legislature in the 1898 New York state election.

en.s: The 1905 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 17, 1905. Incumbent Senator Chauncey Depew was re-elected to a second term in office. en.s: The Terra Nova Expedition, officially the British Antarctic Expedition, was an expedition to Antarctica which took place between 1910 and 1913. Led by Captain Robert Falcon Scott, the expedition had various scientific and geographical objectives. Scott wished to continue the scientific work that he had begun when leading the Discovery Expedition from 1901 to 1904, and wanted to be the first to reach the geographic South Pole. He and four companions attained the pole on 17 January 1912, where they found that a Norwegian team led by Roald Amundsen had preceded them by 34 days.

zh.s: 新地号探险正式名称为英国南极探险，于1910年至1913年进行，由罗伯特·福尔肯·斯科特上校率领，承担多项科学与地理考察任务。斯科特希望继续他在1901年至1904年发现号探险中开展的研究，并率先抵达地理南极点。1912年1月17日，他和四名同伴到达南极点，却发现罗尔德·阿蒙森率领的挪威队早在34天前就已抵达。

en.t: Russia defeats Ottoman Turkey in the Battle of Sarikamish during the Caucasus Campaign of World War I
en.s: The Battle of Sarikamish was an engagement between the Russian and Ottoman Empires during World War I. It took place from 22 December 1914, to 17 January 1915, as part of the Caucasus campaign. The battle resulted in a decisive Russian victory. The Ottoman plan relied on highly mobile troops capable of reaching specific objectives at precise times, drawing on German and Napoleonic tactical principles.

zh.t: 萨勒卡默什战役俄军获胜
zh.s: 萨勒卡默什战役是第一次世界大战期间俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场交战，作为高加索战役的一部分，从1914年12月22日持续至1915年1月17日，以俄军决定性胜利告终。奥斯曼军队的计划借鉴德国与拿破仑式战术思想，要求高机动部队按精确时间抵达指定目标。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Guatemala on 17 January 1916. For the second successive election, Manuel Estrada Cabrera was re-elected unopposed. Despite there only being one candidate, voters were rounded up by the military and taken to polling stations, where they could only vote for Cabrera. Cabrera assumed the presidency on 15 March 1911.

zh.s: 1916年1月17日，危地马拉举行总统选举。曼努埃尔·埃斯特拉达·卡夫雷拉连续第二次在无人竞争的情况下连任。虽然只有一名候选人，军方仍把选民集中带往投票站，他们在那里只能投票给卡夫雷拉。原文将他此次开始担任总统的日期记为1911年3月15日。

en.s: On 17 January 1918, Chinese troops on the banks of the Yangtze River fired on the American gunboat USS Monocacy near Chenglin, China. The gunboat returned fire.

zh.t: 美舰“莫诺卡西”号长江交火事件
zh.s: 1918年1月17日，中国长江沿岸的军队在城陵矶附近向美国炮舰“莫诺卡西”号开火，该舰随后还击。

en.t: US national alcohol prohibition takes effect
en.s: On January 17, 1920, national alcohol prohibition took effect in the United States under the Eighteenth Amendment and the relevant provisions of the Volstead Act. Some provisions of the act had already taken effect in October 1919.

zh.s: 1920年1月17日，美国宪法第十八修正案及《沃尔斯特德法》的相关条款开始实施，全国禁酒令由此生效。该法的部分条款此前已于1919年10月生效。

en.s: The Newcastle-upon-Tyne East by-election of 1923 was held on 17 January 1923. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Labour MP, Joseph Nicholas Bell.

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1928 was held on January 17, 1928. Like in most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the Democratic Party primary held on this date was the real contest over who would be governor. The 1928 election resulted in the election of Huey Long as Governor of Louisiana, and created a political realignment in the state between Long and anti-Long factions that lasted for several decades.

zh.t: 1928年美国路易斯安那州州长选举
zh.s: 1928年1月17日，路易斯安那州举行州长选举。在重建时期至民权运动年代之间，该州与多数南方州一样，共和党几乎没有选举支持，因此当天的民主党初选才是真正决定州长人选的角逐。休伊·朗最终当选，此后该州形成支持朗与反对朗的两大政治阵营，持续数十年。

en.s: On 17 January 1931, writer Hu Yepin was arrested with other attendees at a secret Chinese Communist Party meeting at the Oriental Hotel in the Shanghai International Settlement. British police carried out the arrests.

zh.s: 1931年1月17日，作家胡也频在上海公共租界东方旅社参加中共秘密会议时，与其他与会者一起被英国警察逮捕。

en.s: The Battle of Ko Chang took place on 17 January 1941 during the Franco-Thai War. A flotilla of French warships attacked a smaller force of Thai vessels, including a coastal defence ship. The battle resulted in a tactical victory by the French Navy over the Royal Thai Navy, although the strategic result is dubious. Two Thai ships were sunk and one was heavily damaged, with no French losses.

zh.s: 1941年1月17日，象岛海战在法泰战争期间爆发。法国舰队攻击了规模较小的泰国舰队，泰方参战舰只包括一艘海防舰。法国海军取得战术胜利，但此战的战略意义仍有争议。两艘泰国舰艇沉没，一艘严重受损，法方没有损失。

en.s: Convoy PQ 8 (8–17 January 1942) was an Arctic convoy of the Western Allies to aid the Soviet Union during the Second World War. The convoy left Iceland on 8 January 1942. On 12 January the convoy had to turn south to avoid ice; the weather was calm, visibility was exceptional, with a short period of twilight around noon. The convoy arrived in Murmansk nine days later.

en.t: Soviet forces take Warsaw during the Vistula–Oder offensive
en.s: On 17 January 1945, Soviet forces entered Warsaw as German forces abandoned the city during the Vistula–Oder offensive. They encountered the destruction left after the Warsaw Uprising.

zh.t: 维斯瓦河—奥得河攻势中苏军进入华沙
zh.s: 1945年1月17日，维斯瓦河—奥得河攻势期间，德军撤离华沙，苏军进入该城，看到华沙起义后城市遭到严重破坏的景象。

en.t: First meeting of the United Nations Security Council
en.s: On 17 January 1946, the United Nations Security Council held its first meeting at Church House in Westminster, London.

zh.t: 联合国安理会首次开会
zh.s: 1946年1月17日，联合国安全理事会在伦敦威斯敏斯特的教会大楼举行首次会议。

en.s: The Renville Agreement was a United Nations Security Council-brokered political accord between the Netherlands, which was seeking to re-establish its colony in Southeast Asia, and Indonesian Republicans seeking Indonesian independence during the Indonesian National Revolution. Ratified on 17 January 1948, the agreement was an unsuccessful attempt to resolve the disputes that arose following the 1946 Linggadjati Agreement.

zh.s: 《伦维尔协定》是联合国安理会斡旋达成的政治协议，双方为试图恢复东南亚殖民统治的荷兰和争取独立的印度尼西亚共和派。协定在印度尼西亚民族革命期间达成，于1948年1月17日获批准，旨在解决1946年《林牙椰蒂协定》之后出现的争端，但未能成功。

en.s: United Nations Security Council Resolution 79, adopted on January 17, 1950, having received and the text of United Nations General Assembly Resolution 300 concerning the regulation and general reduction of conventional armaments and armed forces, the Council decided to transmit the resolution to the Commission for Conventional Armaments for further study in accordance with the Commission’s plan of work. The resolution was adopted with nine votes.

zh.t: 联合国安理会第79号决议
zh.s: 1950年1月17日，联合国安理会通过第79号决议。安理会收到有关管制和普遍削减常规军备及武装力量的联大第300号决议文本后，决定将其转交常规军备委员会，按照该委员会的工作计划进一步研究。决议获得九票赞成。

en.t: Final day of Finland’s 1950 presidential elector voting
en.s: On 17 January 1950, Finland completed its two-day popular voting to choose presidential electors. The electors subsequently chose the president; the overall election returned Juho Kusti Paasikivi to office.

zh.t: 芬兰1950年总统选举人投票结束
zh.s: 1950年1月17日，芬兰为期两天的总统选举人投票结束。民众先选出选举人，再由选举人选出总统；此次选举最终由尤霍·库斯蒂·巴锡基维连任。

en.t: 1951 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election
en.s: The 1951 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election was held on 17 January to choose the fifth leader of the New Zealand Labour Party. The election was won by Hutt MP and incumbent deputy-leader Walter Nash.

zh.s: 1951年1月17日，新西兰工党举行党首选举，选出该党的第五任领袖。赫特选区议员、时任副党首沃尔特·纳什赢得选举。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1956 was held on January 17, 1956. The 1956 election saw the election of Earl K. Long to his second full term as Governor of Louisiana. He received over 50% of the vote, defeating his opponents so soundly that no runoff vote was needed.

zh.t: 1956年美国路易斯安那州州长选举
zh.s: 1956年1月17日，路易斯安那州举行州长选举，厄尔·K.朗当选，开始第二个完整州长任期。他得票超过50%，大幅领先对手，因此无须第二轮投票。

en.s: The Battle of La Plata was a battle fought on January 17, 1957, in the coastal village of La Plata in the Sierra Maestra mountain range of Cuba during the Cuban Revolution. It is notable as the first battle of the revolution following the Landing of the Granma which was a success for the rebels, who had previously suffered a heavy defeat at the Battle of Alegría de Pío in which the vast majority of their forces had been killed, wounded or captured.

zh.s: 1957年1月17日，古巴革命中的拉普拉塔战役，在马埃斯特拉山脉的沿海村庄拉普拉塔展开。这是起义军乘“格拉玛”号登陆后首次打赢的战斗。此前，他们在阿莱格里亚德皮奥战役中遭重创，绝大多数人员被杀、受伤或被俘。

en.t: Patrice Lumumba and two colleagues killed in Katanga
en.s: On 17 January 1961, Patrice Lumumba, Maurice Mpolo and Joseph Okito were killed near Elisabethville in Katanga, in present-day Democratic Republic of the Congo. Lumumba had been the country’s first prime minister. A later Belgian parliamentary inquiry placed the execution on that evening.

zh.t: 卢蒙巴与两名同僚在加丹加被杀
zh.s: 1961年1月17日，帕特里斯·卢蒙巴、莫里斯·姆波洛和约瑟夫·奥基托在加丹加伊丽莎白维尔附近被杀，该地位于今刚果民主共和国。卢蒙巴曾任该国首任总理。比利时议会后来的调查将处决时间确定在当晚。

en.s: 1964 Emperor's Cup Final was the 44th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Kobe Oji Stadium in Hyōgo on January 17, 1965. Yawata Steel and Furukawa Electric won the championship.

zh.s: 1964年天皇杯决赛是该项赛事的第44届决赛，于1965年1月17日在兵库县的神户王子体育场举行。八幡制铁与古河电工共同获得冠军。

en.s: The Palomares accident occurred on 17 January 1966, when a United States Air Force B-52G bomber collided with a KC-135 tanker during mid-air refueling at 31,000 feet (9,450 m) over the Mediterranean Sea, near the Spanish village of Palomares in Almería province. The collision destroyed the tanker, killing all four crew members, and caused the bomber to break apart, resulting in the deaths of three of its seven crew members.

zh.s: 1966年1月17日，美国空军一架B-52G轰炸机在西班牙阿尔梅里亚省帕洛马雷斯村附近的地中海上空，与一架KC-135加油机相撞。两机当时正在31,000英尺（9,450米）高空进行空中加油。加油机被撞毁，四名机组人员全部遇难；轰炸机解体，七名机组人员中三人遇难。

en.s: On 17 January 1977, a group of French-led mercenaries tried and failed to overthrow the government of the People's Republic of Benin led by Mathieu Kérékou, whose communist party—the People's Revolutionary Party of Benin (PRPB)—was the only allowed political party in the country. The coup, which was also known as Opération Crevette ("Operation Shrimp"), included a failed invasion of the port city of Cotonou by mercenaries contracted by a group of exiled Beninese political rivals.

zh.s: 1977年1月17日，一支由法国人率领的雇佣军试图推翻马蒂厄·克雷库领导的贝宁人民共和国政府，但未能成功。这次政变也称“虾行动”。雇佣军受一批流亡贝宁的反对派人士雇用，进攻港口城市科托努失败。当时，克雷库领导的贝宁人民革命党是该国唯一合法政党。

en.t: Gary Gilmore executed as US executions resume
en.s: On January 17, 1977, convicted murderer Gary Gilmore was executed by firing squad in Utah. His execution marked the resumption of executions in the United States after a ten-year hiatus.

zh.t: 加里·吉尔摩被处决，美国恢复执行死刑
zh.s: 1977年1月17日，被判谋杀罪的加里·吉尔摩在犹他州被行刑队枪决。此次处决标志着美国在中断十年后恢复执行死刑。

en.s: The 1978–79 Durand Cup final was the 74th final of the Durand Cup, the oldest football competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giants East Bengal and Mohun Bagan on 17 January 1979 at the Ambedkar Stadium in New Delhi. East Bengal won the final 3–0 to claim their 8th Durand Cup title.

zh.s: 1979年1月17日，第74届杜兰德杯决赛在印度新德里的安贝德卡尔体育场举行，由加尔各答两大劲旅东孟加拉与莫亨巴甘对阵。杜兰德杯是印度历史最悠久的足球赛事。东孟加拉以3比0获胜，第八次夺冠。

en.t: Ian Sinclair elected leader of Australia’s National Party
en.s: On 17 January 1984, following Doug Anthony’s retirement, Australia’s National Party elected Ian Sinclair as leader. Ralph Hunt was elected deputy leader.

zh.t: 伊恩·辛克莱当选澳大利亚国家党领袖
zh.s: 1984年1月17日，道格·安东尼退休后，澳大利亚国家党选举伊恩·辛克莱为党领袖，拉尔夫·亨特当选副领袖。

en.s: On January 17, 1988, the inaugural HASC benefit concert took place at Avery Fisher Hall in New York. The concert raised support for Camp HASC, a summer camp for children with special needs.

zh.s: 1988年1月17日，首届HASC慈善音乐会在纽约艾弗里·费舍尔音乐厅举行，为面向有特殊需要儿童的HASC夏令营筹集支持。

en.s: The Stockton schoolyard shooting occurred at Cleveland Elementary School in Stockton, California, on January 17, 1989. The perpetrator, 24-year-old Patrick Purdy, shot and killed five children and wounded thirty-one others—all but one of them children—before committing suicide approximately three minutes after first opening fire. The shooting sparked intense public controversy regarding private ownership of assault weapons, and ultimately inspired the Roberti–Roos Assault Weapons Control Act of 1989, which prohibited the ownership and transfer of over fifty specific brands and models of assault weapons in California.

zh.t: 美国斯托克顿校园枪击案
zh.s: 1989年1月17日，美国加利福尼亚州斯托克顿的克利夫兰小学发生枪击案。24岁的帕特里克·珀迪开枪杀害五名儿童，打伤31人，伤者除一人外也都是儿童。他在首次开枪约三分钟后自杀。事件引发有关私人持有攻击性武器的激烈争论，并最终推动1989年《罗伯蒂—鲁斯攻击性武器管制法》出台，禁止在加州持有和转让五十多种指定品牌、型号的攻击性武器。

en.s: On January 17, 1994, at 04:30:55 Pacific Standard Time, a magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Greater Los Angeles area in California, United States. Its epicenter was beneath the San Fernando Valley.

zh.s: 1994年1月17日太平洋标准时间凌晨4时30分55秒，美国加利福尼亚州大洛杉矶地区发生矩震级6.7级地震，震中位于圣费尔南多谷地下。

en.s: The Kobe earthquake, also known as the Great Hanshin Earthquake (Japanese: 阪神淡路大震災, Hepburn: Hanshin-Awaji daishinsai), occurred on January 17, 1995, at 05:46:53 JST in the southern part of Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan, including the region of Hanshin. It measured 6.9 on the moment magnitude scale and had a maximum intensity of 7 on the JMA Seismic Intensity Scale (XI on the Modified Mercalli intensity scale). The tremors lasted for approximately 20 seconds. The hypocenter of the earthquake was located 17 km beneath its epicenter, on the northern end of Awaji Island, 20 km away from the center of the city of Kobe.

zh.s: 1995年1月17日日本时间5时46分53秒，日本兵库县南部，包括阪神地区，发生地震，也称神户地震或阪神淡路大地震。矩震级为6.9级，最大日本气象厅震度为7，对应修订麦加利烈度XI度。震动持续约20秒，震源深17公里，震中位于淡路岛北端，距神户市中心约20公里。

en.t: 1995 Italian Super Cup played in January 1996
en.s: On 17 January 1996, Juventus defeated Parma 1–0 in the 1995 Italian Super Cup at the Stadio delle Alpi in Turin. Scheduling conflicts had delayed the match until January 1996.

zh.t: 延期举行的1995年意大利超级杯
zh.s: 1996年1月17日，尤文图斯在都灵阿尔卑球场以1比0击败帕尔马，夺得1995年意大利超级杯。由于赛程冲突，这场比赛延至1996年1月举行。

en.t: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station: A Delta II carrying the GPS IIR-1 satellite explodes 13 seconds after launch, dropping 250 tons of burning rocket remains around the launch pad
en.s: GPS IIR-1 or GPS SVN-42 was the first Block IIR GPS satellite to be launched. It was to have been operated as part of the United States Air Force Global Positioning System. It was launched on 17 January 1997, and was destroyed 13 seconds into its flight due to a malfunction of the Delta II launch vehicle that was carrying it.

zh.s: GPS IIR-1又称GPS SVN-42，是首颗发射的Block IIR型GPS卫星，原计划用于美国空军的全球定位系统。卫星于1997年1月17日发射，但搭载它的德尔塔II型运载火箭发生故障，卫星在升空13秒后被毁。

en.s: Souled Out (1999) was the third Souled Out professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on January 17, 1999, from the Charleston Civic Center in Charleston, West Virginia. The main event was a Stun Gun ladder match between Scott Hall and Goldberg, based on Hall helping Kevin Nash in beating Goldberg for the WCW World Heavyweight Championship and ending Goldberg's undefeated streak, the previous month at Starrcade.

zh.s: 1999年1月17日，世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）在美国西弗吉尼亚州查尔斯顿市政中心，举办第三届“Souled Out”按次付费赛事。压轴赛由斯科特·霍尔与高柏进行电击枪梯子赛。故事背景是，霍尔在前一个月的“Starrcade”赛事中帮助凯文·纳什击败高柏，夺走WCW世界重量级冠军，并终结其不败纪录。

en.s: The 2000 Istanbul raids (Turkish: 2000 İstanbul baskınları) were Turkish raids on safehouses operated by the Kurdish Hezbollah on January 17, 2000. The raids resulted in the death of Hüseyin Velioğlu, and severely weakened Hezbollah. The main raid was in Beykoz, while other raids were done in Üsküdar and Ümraniye. The raids were described as being the events that marked the beginning of Hezbollah's “decline”.

zh.s: 2000年1月17日，土耳其对库尔德真主党在伊斯坦布尔的藏身处发动突袭，导致侯赛因·韦利奥卢死亡，并严重削弱了该组织。主要行动在贝伊科兹展开，其他行动涉及于斯屈达尔和于姆拉尼耶。这些突袭被视为该组织走向衰落的转折点。

The Tobago Council of the People's National Movement won 11 seats with 58.02% of the vote, while the Democratic Action Congress won one seat with 40.41% of the vote.

en.s: On January 17, 2007, Al Ittihad defeated Al Ahly Tripoli 1–0 at the 11 June Stadium in the 2006 Libyan Super Cup. It was Al Ittihad’s fifth consecutive victory in the competition.

zh.s: 2007年1月17日，伊蒂哈德在六月十一日体育场以1比0击败的黎波里阿赫利，赢得2006年利比亚超级杯。这是伊蒂哈德连续第五次夺得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: British Airways Flight 38 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Beijing Capital International Airport in Beijing, China, to Heathrow Airport in London, United Kingdom, an 8,100-kilometre (4,400 nmi; 5,000 mi) trip. On 17 January 2008, the Boeing 777 aircraft crash-landed short of runway 27L at Heathrow. Of the 152 people on board, 47 were injured, 1 of them seriously.

zh.t: 英国航空38号班机迫降事故
zh.s: 英国航空38号班机是从中国北京首都国际机场飞往英国伦敦希思罗机场的定期国际客运航班，航程约8,100公里。2008年1月17日，执飞的波音777在尚未到达希思罗27L跑道的位置迫降。机上152人中有47人受伤，其中一人重伤。

en.s: Kuala Terengganu by-election of 2009 was held on 17 January 2009 after the death of the incumbent Member of Parliament, Razali Ismail. In the 2008 election, Datuk Razali won by a slim 628 vote majority, defeating Pan-Malaysian Islamic Party (PAS) heavyweight Mohamad Sabu and 89-year-old independent candidate, Maimun Yusuf. Prime Minister Datuk Seri Abdullah Ahmad Badawi and Barisan Nasional were confident that Barisan Nasional would retain the Kuala Terengganu parliamentary seat. The Prime Minister had rejected the assumption that there would be a big swing by the voters to the Opposition.

zh.t: 2009年马来西亚瓜拉登嘉楼补选
zh.s: 2009年1月17日，马来西亚瓜拉登嘉楼举行国会议席补选，原因是现任议员拉扎里·依斯迈去世。2008年大选时，拿督拉扎里以仅628票优势，击败伊斯兰党重量级人物莫哈末·沙布及89岁的独立候选人麦蒙·尤索夫。首相拿督斯里阿都拉·阿末·巴达维与国民阵线有信心守住该议席，首相也否认选民会大幅转向反对党的假设。

en.s: The 2008–09 W-League grand final was the grand final of the inaugural season of the W-League, the premier league of football (soccer) in Australia. Top of the table in the regular season Queensland Roar hosted home-and-away third-placed Canberra United FC at Ballymore Stadium in Herston, Brisbane in the Saturday 17 January 2009 season decider. In a closely contested match, the Roar defeated United 2–0.

zh.t: 2009年1月澳大利亚女足联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2009年1月17日星期六，首届澳大利亚顶级女子足球联赛W联赛的2008—2009赛季总决赛，在布里斯班赫斯顿的巴利莫尔体育场举行。常规赛榜首昆士兰狮吼主场迎战主客场赛阶段排名第三的堪培拉联。双方竞争激烈，最终狮吼以2比0获胜。

en.s: The Ukrainian presidential election of 2010 was Ukraine's fifth presidential election since declaring independence from the Soviet Union in 1991. The first round was held on January 17, 2010. The run-off between Prime Minister Yulia Tymoshenko and opposition leader Viktor Yanukovych followed on February 7, 2010. On February 14, Viktor Yanukovych, with 48.95% of the popular vote, was declared President-elect and winner of the 2010 Ukrainian Presidential election. According to Article 104 of Ukraine's Constitution, the President must be sworn into office within 30 days from the official declaration of the poll before the Ukrainian parliament.

zh.s: 2010年乌克兰总统选举，是该国1991年宣布脱离苏联独立以来的第五次总统选举。首轮于1月17日举行，2月7日由总理尤利娅·季莫申科与反对党领袖维克托·亚努科维奇进行第二轮角逐。2月14日，亚努科维奇以48.95%的得票率被宣布为获胜者及候任总统。根据乌克兰宪法第104条，总统必须在正式公布结果后的30天内，在议会面前宣誓就职。

en.s: The 2010 Genesis was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on January 17, 2010 at the TNA Impact! Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the fifth event under the Genesis chronology and the first event of the 2010 TNA PPV schedule. The PPV poster was released in early December 2009, promoting Hulk Hogan's debut on TNA PPV.

zh.s: 2012年1月17日，阿扎瓦德民族解放运动的武装组织发动第一次梅纳卡战役，标志着2012年图阿雷格叛乱开始。这是一系列战斗的第一场，叛军企图从政府军手中夺取马里北部大部分地区。

en.t: Murder of Shehzad Luqman in Athens
en.s: In the early hours of 17 January 2013, Shehzad Luqman, a 27-year-old man of Pakistani origin, was murdered while cycling to work in Petralona, Athens. Two Golden Dawn members were arrested and convicted of the murder.

zh.t: 谢赫扎德·卢克曼在雅典遇害
zh.s: 2013年1月17日凌晨，27岁的巴基斯坦裔男子谢赫扎德·卢克曼骑车前往工作地点时，在雅典佩特拉洛纳遇害。两名金色黎明成员被捕，后被判谋杀罪成立。

en.s: On 17 January 2014, Pahang defeated LionsXII 1–0 at the Darul Makmur Stadium in Kuantan, Malaysia, to win the 2014 Piala Sumbangsih. The match drew 40,000 spectators.

zh.s: 2014年1月17日，彭亨队在马来西亚关丹的达鲁马莫体育场以1比0击败十二狮队，夺得2014年马来西亚慈善盾杯。现场共有40,000名观众。

en.t: World Series of Fighting 17: Shields vs. Foster
en.s: World Series of Fighting 17: Shields vs. Foster was a mixed martial arts event held January 17, 2015 in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States. This event aired on NBCSN in the U.S and on TSN2 in Canada.

en.t: Conclusion of the CHP’s 35th ordinary convention
en.s: On 17 January 2016, Turkey’s Republican People’s Party concluded its 35th ordinary convention, which had begun on 16 January. The meeting followed the party’s defeat in the November 2015 general election.

zh.t: 土耳其共和人民党第35次常规代表大会闭幕
zh.s: 2016年1月17日，土耳其共和人民党第35次常规代表大会结束。大会于1月16日开幕，是该党在2015年11月大选失利之后举行的会议。

en.s: On 17 January 2017, the Syrian Army began an offensive in eastern Aleppo province. Its objectives included preventing further advances by Turkish-backed rebels, capturing the Islamic State stronghold of Dayr Hafir, and securing water infrastructure and the Jirah military airbase.

zh.s: 2017年1月17日，叙利亚军队在阿勒颇省东部发起攻势。行动目标包括阻止土耳其支持的反对派继续推进、夺取“伊斯兰国”据点代尔哈菲尔，以及控制供水设施和吉拉赫军用机场。

en.t: Underwater search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 suspended
en.s: On 17 January 2017, the underwater search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 was suspended. The aircraft had disappeared on 8 March 2014, prompting a multinational search in Southeast Asia and the southern Indian Ocean.

zh.s: 2017年1月17日，马来西亚航空MH370航班的水下搜寻暂停。该机于2014年3月8日失踪，此后多国在东南亚及南印度洋展开搜寻。

en.s: The 2019 Bloc Québécois leadership election was initiated by the resignation of party leader Martine Ouellet in June 2018. While originally scheduled to be held on February 24, 2019 on a one member, one vote basis, Yves-François Blanchet, as the only candidate in the race following the nomination deadline of January 15, 2019, was officially acclaimed Leader of the Bloc Québécois on January 17, 2019.

zh.s: 2018年6月，魁人政团党首马蒂娜·韦莱辞职，随后启动党首选举。选举原定于2019年2月24日按照一人一票方式举行，但1月15日提名截止后，伊夫-弗朗索瓦·布朗谢成为唯一候选人，因此于2019年1月17日正式自动当选党首。

en.s: The 2021 Supercopa de España final decided the winner of the 2021 Supercopa de España, the 37th edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 17 January 2021 at the Estadio de La Cartuja in Seville, Spain. The match was a clásico between Barcelona and Athletic Bilbao. Athletic Bilbao won the match 3–2 after extra time to win their third Supercopa de España title.

en.s: An avalanche struck a road in Nyingchi at around 7:50 PM China Standard Time on 17 January 2023. Twenty-eight people were killed and 53 others were rescued, five of whom were seriously injured. Local reports attributed the avalanche to high winds and warming temperatures, and identified most of the victims as travelers during the spring travel rush prior to the Chinese New Year.

zh.s: 2023年1月17日北京时间19时50分左右，林芝一条道路发生雪崩，造成28人死亡。另有53人获救，其中五人重伤。当地报道将雪崩归因于强风和气温升高，并指出多数遇难者是春节前春运期间出行的旅客。

en.s: On 17 January 2026, an ATR 42 operated by Indonesia Air Transport crashed in the Bulusaraung mountain area of South Sulawesi, Indonesia. It had been flying from Adisutjipto Airport to Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport. All ten people aboard were killed.

zh.t: 2026年印度尼西亚航空运输公司ATR 42空难
zh.s: 2026年1月17日，印度尼西亚航空运输公司一架ATR 42飞机在印度尼西亚南苏拉威西的布卢萨劳恩山地区坠毁。该机原由阿迪苏吉普托机场飞往苏丹哈桑丁国际机场，机上十人全部遇难。
